module_summary: Direct-mapped ARP cache: CRC32 LFSR hashes of IP addresses index valid/IP/MAC memories; queries compare stored IP for hit or error, writes are registered then committed, and clear sweeps all entries.

anchors.name: ip_addr_mem
anchors.why: Stored IP tag per entry, compared against queried IP for hit detection.

anchors.name: mac_addr_mem
anchors.why: Stored MAC per entry, read out as query response.

anchors.name: valid_mem
anchors.why: Per-entry valid bit, cleared by cache sweep, qualifies hits.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Query index from IP hash addressing valid/IP/MAC memories.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write index from IP hash, or sweep counter during cache clear.

anchors.name: query_request_hash
anchors.why: LFSR hash of query IP, low bits load rd_ptr.

anchors.name: write_request_hash
anchors.why: LFSR hash of write IP, low bits load wr_ptr.

anchors.name: query_ip_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending query flag; triggers lookup compare and response generation.

anchors.name: query_ip_reg
anchors.why: Latched query IP compared with stored IP tag.

anchors.name: write_ip_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending write flag committing latched IP/MAC to memories.

anchors.name: write_ip_reg
anchors.why: Latched write IP/MAC awaiting commit to cache memories.

anchors.name: mem_write
anchors.why: Memory write enable for entry commit or clear sweep.

anchors.name: store_query
anchors.why: Load enable latching query IP on request accept.

anchors.name: store_write
anchors.why: Load enable latching write IP/MAC on request accept.

anchors.name: query_request_valid
anchors.why: Query request valid accepting a lookup IP.

anchors.name: query_request_ready
anchors.why: Query ready, low during cache clear or stalled response.

anchors.name: query_request_ip
anchors.why: Lookup IP hashed into cache index.

anchors.name: query_response_valid
anchors.why: Query response valid with MAC and error.

anchors.name: query_response_ready
anchors.why: Downstream response ready clearing response valid.

anchors.name: query_response_mac
anchors.why: MAC read from cache for the queried IP.

anchors.name: query_response_error
anchors.why: Miss indication when entry invalid or IP tag mismatches.

anchors.name: write_request_valid
anchors.why: Write request valid inserting an IP/MAC pair.

anchors.name: write_request_ready
anchors.why: Write ready, low during cache clear.

anchors.name: write_request_mac
anchors.why: MAC to store for the written IP.

groups.name: Cache memories
groups.description: Direct-mapped valid, IP tag and MAC arrays.

groups.name: Query path
groups.description: Hash query IP, read entry, compare tag, return MAC or error.

groups.name: Write and clear path
groups.description: Hash write IP, latch IP/MAC and commit; clear sweeps wr_ptr over all entries.
